user.title: iCloud Shared Album
user.description: Paste the album's public link. In Photos on iPhone, open the shared album, tap the people icon and turn on Public Website, then Share Link. Only this album is read; no Apple ID is used.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like an iCloud shared album link.
error.not_public: The album isn't shared as a public website. Turn on Public Website for it in Photos.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't read the album from iCloud. Check the link and try again.

get_photos.name: Get photos
get_photos.description: Returns the album's photos, newest first, with image URLs served by Home Assistant.

entity_id.name: Album
entity_id.description: The album's Photos sensor. Leave empty for every album.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Return only the newest N photos.

check_images.name: Check images
check_images.description: Diagnostics: fetches every photo from iCloud and reports its format and any errors.
